summary: POET Technologies filed a Form 6-K with an attached press release reporting Q2 2026 financial results. Revenue was $569,925, up 112% year-over-year, net loss narrowed to $11.3 million, and cash totaled $796.3 million after a $400 million strategic investment completed in May. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure, not a special-situation event. The CEO's commentary mentions the financing priced at a premium to market, a new COO appointment, and a subsequent purchase order, but none constitute an M&A or restructuring event. The filing describes ordinary operational progress.
